**Steps to reproduce the issue:**

comments.author: lguohan
comments.body:
based on the message here. it looks like maybe related to python2 and python3 issue here.

gather_lldp\nTypeError: 'str' object does not support item assignment

Can you check if gather_lldp is compatiable with python3?

comments.author: theasianpianist
comments.body:
The problem turned out to be with the output of `lldpctl -f keyvalue`, specifically that it contained multiple unknown TLVs:

```
lldp.eth0.unknown-tlvs.unknown-tlv.oui=00,01,42
lldp.eth0.unknown-tlvs.unknown-tlv.subtype=1
lldp.eth0.unknown-tlvs.unknown-tlv.len=1
lldp.eth0.unknown-tlvs.unknown-tlv=01
lldp.eth0.unknown-tlvs.unknown-tlv.oui=00,01,42
lldp.eth0.unknown-tlvs.unknown-tlv.subtype=2
lldp.eth0.unknown-tlvs.unknown-tlv.len=16
```

The Ansible LLDP module is unable to parse duplicate keys, leading to the crash.

A method can be added to the pretest to filter out these keys from the `lldpctl` output on the device, and that change can be reverted in the posttest.

linkedPullRequests.title: [lldpctl patch] patch lldpctl script to work around ansible bug
linkedPullRequests.author: yxieca
linkedPullRequests.body:
Summary:
Fixes #2558 

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Ansible 2.8.12 has a bug in lldp module, when lldpctl -f keyvalue shows multiple unknown-tlvs for a single interface, it will throw
exception.

#### How did you do it?
This change is to work around the ansible lldp module issue for the time being.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Run lldp/test_lldp.py, test passes.
Run snmp/test_snmp_lldp.py. test passes.

Signed-off-by: Ying Xie <ying.xie@microsoft.com>
